description:
The Marriage Assistance Scheme under the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (O.B.O.C.W.W.B) was launched in the year 2008.

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the daughters of construction workers in Odisha who are getting married.

The primary objective of the scheme is to alleviate the financial burden on families of construction workers during the marriage of their daughters.

The scheme specifically targets the daughters of registered construction workers who are members of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

Under this scheme, a financial assistance of ₹50,000 is provided for the marriage of each daughter.

The assistance is aimed at ensuring that families do not face financial hardships during the marriage ceremony.

The scheme is designed to promote the welfare of construction workers and their families by providing them with necessary financial support.

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a daughter of a registered construction worker.

The construction worker must be registered with the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The applicant must be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage.

There is no upper age limit specified for the applicant.

The income of the construction worker must not exceed ₹10,000 per month to qualify for the assistance.

The application process for the Marriage Assistance Scheme involves several steps.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the local office of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the board.

The applicant must fill in the required details in the application form.

The following documents are required to be submitted along with the application form.

A copy of the marriage invitation card must be provided.

A copy of the construction worker's registration certificate is required.

Proof of age such as a birth certificate or school leaving certificate must be submitted.

A copy of the Aadhaar card of the applicant is also necessary.

Once the application form is completed and the documents are gathered, the applicant must submit them to the local office of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The application will be reviewed by the officials of the board.

If the application is found to be in order, the financial assistance will be sanctioned.

The assistance amount will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The disbursement of funds typically occurs within 30 days of the application being approved.

The scheme is implemented by the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employees' State Insurance, Government of Odisha.

The contact details for the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board can be found on their official website.

The board also provides additional welfare schemes for construction workers and their families.

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the living conditions of construction workers in Odisha.

Since its inception, the scheme has benefited thousands of families across the state.

The government has allocated significant funds for the implementation of this scheme each year.

In the financial year 2022-2023, the government allocated ₹50 crores for various welfare schemes under the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The scheme has seen an increase in the number of beneficiaries over the years.

In 2021 alone, approximately 10,000 applications were received under the Marriage Assistance Scheme.

The scheme has been praised for its role in empowering women by providing them with financial support during a crucial life event.

The assistance provided under this scheme is intended to reduce the incidence of child marriage by encouraging families to invest in their daughters' futures.

The board regularly conducts awareness programs to inform construction workers about the benefits available under this scheme.

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a vital part of the government's efforts to support the construction workforce in Odisha.

The scheme aligns with the government's commitment to improving gender equality and women's empowerment.

The financial assistance helps families to conduct marriages in a dignified manner without incurring debts.

The scheme is also a part of the larger framework of social security measures for workers in the unorganized sector.

The Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board has been proactive in updating the scheme to meet the needs of the beneficiaries.

The board has also introduced online application facilities to streamline the process.

This digital initiative aims to make the application process more accessible and efficient for beneficiaries.

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is an example of targeted welfare policies aimed at specific demographics within the workforce.

The scheme has a significant impact on the social fabric of the community by promoting responsible marriage practices.

The financial assistance provided can also be used for other related expenses such as pre-wedding ceremonies and celebrations.

The scheme has been instrumental in reducing the financial stress associated with marriages in lower-income families.

The Odisha government continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the Marriage Assistance Scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme and address any challenges faced during the application process.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the welfare of construction workers and their families.

In conclusion, the Marriage Assistance Scheme under the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board is a crucial initiative aimed at supporting the daughters of construction workers during their marriages.
